title: CMA fines ticket provider £900,000 over hidden fees
discussion_signal: The post describes the CMA converting hidden mandatory checkout fees into a concrete enforcement remedy: upfront pricing requirements, a fine, and refunds to affected ticket buyers.
linked_research_question: How can hidden live-event pricing become a cultural-access barrier that is converted into automatic consumer remedy?
limits: The post is legal and professional commentary on one enforcement action
Refunds and fines do not establish whether future compliance holds
It does not measure how hidden fees affect lower-income cultural participation
